messages:
mira: PTQ canary for nebula-lite (int4) is spiking funcall parse failures — baseline ~1.2% -> 4.6% since the int4 profile rolled. Repro on canary run 2026-03-20. Posting examples and quick notes.

sam: can you paste a raw failing output? quick glance for trailing commas / extra prose after the JSON.

mira: here's one raw chunk we captured: 
```json
{\"tool\": \"lookup_person\", \"args\": {\"id\": \"u_123\"}}Note: couldn't find id
```
This arrives as a single stream (no newline) and our strict JSON parser bails because of the trailing "Note: couldn't find id" text.

ciara: hmm looks like a suffix-narration after the JSON. i've seen similar when tokenization shifts due to kv-cache prefix differences. zephyr-lite had a similar pattern last quarter.

leo: can we get raw tokens for that output? int4 quant can change spacing/controlchar alignment which breaks naive split heuristics. @mira

mira: dumping tokens from the canary trace (copied verbatim):
```
['{', '\\"', 'tool', '\\"', ':', ' ', '\\"lookup_person\\"', ',', ' ', '\\"args\\"', ':', ' ', '{', '\\"id\\"', ':', ' ', '\\"u_123\\"', '}', '}', 'Note', ':', 'couldn\'t', 'find', 'id']\n```
so the token stream shows a clean JSON token sequence followed by plain-text tokens appended — i.e., model produced JSON then an explanatory suffix.

sam: two likely causes: 1) model confidently emits JSON then continues with explanation more often after PTQ; 2) our streaming boundary detection (stream-sentinel) occasionally merges the following prose into the same response chunk under small batch / kv-prefix scenarios.

ciara: short-term mitigation: relax the parser to accept a trailing suffix after a top-level closing brace for canary traffic only, and treat that as a success (log suffix). Add an opt-out strict flag for enterprise customers.

leo: medium-term: add a sentinel requirement in the prompt template for new onboards (e.g., wrap JSON in <JSON>...</JSON> or append a required token like \"</json>\") so we have an unambiguous stream boundary. Also add a token-dump smoke in the onboarding checklist.

mira: i've applied a canary heuristic toggle (suffix-allow) that accepts trailing non-JSON after a valid top-level object and returns success+suffix in metadata. Reduced regen retries to 0 for the canary to avoid wasted cycles.

ops-bot: deploy 6654322005 by mira: canary config tweak applied :thumbsup:

sam: good. let's capture before/after metrics: token-level diffs, schema conformance, funcall success. will prepare a small report.

ciara: i'll run an evaluation harness over 5k examples (mix of onboarded prompts + synthetic toolcall prompts) and produce a conformance curve. ETA ~6h.

mira: thanks — if we observe >3% drop in schema conformance vs baseline we'll rollback the PTQ profile and flag the release.

leo: also filing a short doc update for the onboarding playbook: add sentinel + token-dump + schema-gate.

mira: PR opened: #4567 (onboard-playbook: add sentinel & token-smoke). cc @release-eng

structbot: alert cleared 6654322129 — canary heuristic applied and monitoring enabled.
